portfolio.note: Total PEP payoff across the portfolio is $1.4 million as of 9/2, down from a little over $2 million at the start, through buybacks and not adding new loans. Seven Winterwood homes carry roughly $350,000 of that, with three close to $60,000 each.

cfo_summary: Total available cash is $65,798 against a true bank balance of $71,029. After $12,016 in external payments and $30,041 in October management fees, projected end of week is $53,782. Twenty five bills, two held.

The credit card and the distribution both cleared. The $38,626.60 card posted and Group Group paid Tim the September distribution, taking GG from $45,086 to $83. Roughly $84,000 left in the same week, which is why available cash fell $45,421 against last week's projection. Beth confirmed the card was in range against a $35,000 monthly average with no overspend.

Trent set a standing instruction on 9/24 to withhold against the card weekly. His question was what we do to avoid being in the same position next month. The answer agreed was to carry a hold back as a line in the bills rather than scrambling at month end. That sits on the watchlist at $10,000 a week from 10/2. The card itself comes off the board now that September has cleared; it averages about $35,000 and drafts around the 26th.

Two insurance holds are now on the board. The first premium has come out and the parks need to fund roughly $10,000 a month across ten months, scheduled after rent hits around the fifth. The second hold, building next year's premium reserve, runs at month end alongside the distribution so the cash is confirmed first. Neither had been tracked before.

GRP opened at negative $7,553 and recovers to $17,746 on the October fees. Sixth negative opening in fourteen weeks. Four entities finish under $5,000: Decade Acres at $1,999, Four Seasons at $2,713, Winterwood at $3,313 and Riverside at $4,591. Group Group sits at $83. Countryside projects to $10,007.

The Vincent funding on the two Four Seasons homes is delayed by a miscommunication. Beth asked him to hold off on funding and he held off on the flood zone verification too. Lisa is restarting it, and underwriting has to complete its own due diligence regardless of the flood certificate. Trent asked on 9/24 to see where Vincent is on those two homes. Consignment sales have been taken off the income board because they do not net GRP meaningful cash.

Decade Acres 31 was deliberately left unfunded so the sale price could be lowered. Trent and Justin both believe a buyer exists at the adjusted price, and it would be cash straight to the bank with no lender in the middle. 44 Waterway had its cash buyer viewing on 9/25 and recoups the rehab investment plus some.

Two Royal Supply invoices totalling $4,262 are held on this run. Both are Net 30 from 9/25 and Beth's read is that Royal holds comfortably. C&K's $5,840, held one week on the 9/25 run after Justin cleared it with Charlie, is released and paid this week. Kenneth Carpenter's $2,000 invoice arrived after the payment window and Justin is verifying the work before it is paid.

Three PEP evictions are in play. Melissa Harris at DA: 54 is confirmed, so the $30,842 buyback will happen and must be floor planned. Trent named Brian Miller and Anthony Figaro on 9/30 as probable. Floor plan remains two homes at $60,745.

for_ownership.label: Projected end-of-week cash
for_ownership.paragraph: We close this week at roughly $53,800 across all accounts. The company credit card of $38,600 cleared and your September distribution was paid, so about $84,000 moved out of the business in the same week. That is why the balance is well down from last Thursday. Going forward we will set money aside against the card each week rather than finding it at month end, and we are also starting the insurance premium holds, about $10,000 a month plus a second hold to build next year's reserve. Golden Rule Practices started the week overdrawn and comes back to about $16,500 once the October management fees transfer in. Four of the nine accounts finish under $5,000. On the sales side, the lien release for 2015 West 3rd arrived faster than expected and a cash buyer looked at 44 Waterway this week.
